turnCoverage.note: §6.3.7: never a reward, never part of the verdict.

issues: Multiple conflicting report versions are concatenated: one states 10/12 references and 67/70 claims, another states 9 references and 41 claims; record counts differ (92 vs 142).
Contradicts the brief by ruling HALP and intra-abdominal sepsis MIMIC-IV cohorts as '可判定为重叠' from shared version/time/center, instead of leaving overlap unresolved.
Treats same database, version and window as proof of overlapping cohorts, violating the mustNotDo instruction against inferring identical cohorts from shared public database use.
Uses a derived expected-overlap estimate (~95 patients) to support a definitive overlap judgement while admitting patient-level overlap cannot be quantified.
Citation-audit and reference-list numbers are internally inconsistent, undermining traceability.
judge.rationale: The delivery is detailed but internally contradictory: multiple concatenated versions report 9/10/12 references, 41/67/70 claims, and 92/142 records. It violates the brief by ruling one pair 'overlapping' from shared version/window/center and using a derived expected-overlap number to support that call, instead of leaving overlap unresolved. A useful model list and needed-information table exist, but inconsistency and overclaim make the evidence untrustworthy. Safety wording avoids patient-level advice and keeps derived estimates separate, so that dimension scores higher.

qualityNotices: MUST FIX — Reading retrieved evidence was delegated to a subagent 2 time(s); a subagent replies in prose, so quotations taken from it are not the source's wording. Read tool-output files with the read tool. Delegate a question, never a document.

MUST FIX — The search log must exactly match successful evidence-search calls from the same run — missing from the log: "prediction model in-hospital mortality intra-abdominal sepsi", "halp score in-hospital mortality sepsis external validation ", "mimic-iv freely accessible electronic health record
